[[File:PICART Catherine Avril2016.jpg|thumb]]
'''Cathérine Cécile Picart''' (born 24 October 1971) is a French [[Biophysics|biophysicist]] and [[Biological engineering|bioengineer]]. She is the Head of the Department of Health at ''[[:fr:CEA Grenoble|CEA Grenoble]]'' ([[French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission]]) in the area of fundamental research, a professor at the ''[[Institut polytechnique de Grenoble]]'' ''[[:fr:École nationale supérieure de physique, électronique, matériaux|École nationale supérieure de physique, électronique, matériaux]]'' (''PHELMA'') and researcher at the ''Laboratoire des Matériaux et du Génie Physique'' (''LMGP'').

==Biography==
In 1994, She graduated from the ''[[Institut polytechnique de Grenoble]]'' with a degree in the physics of materials, and a masters degree in biomedical engineering from the ''[[Université Joseph Fourier]]''. Her doctoral thesis in biomedical engineering was also completed at the ''Université Joseph Fourier'' in 1997. She followed this with a post-doctoral fellowship at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] in 1998. From 1998 to 2004, she lectured at the ''[[Université Louis-Pasteur]]'' in [[Strasbourg]], where she worked in the fields of [[materials science]] and [[biomaterial]]s. In 1998, she joined the ''[[Université de Montpellier]]'' as a professor in the Biology and Health department. She created a team in [[Cell (biology)|cellular]] biophysics and [[Biomimetics|biomimicry]] and while there she won the ''Prix Jean-Marc Lhoste'' from the ''[[:fr:Société française de biophysique|Société française de biophysique]]''. She was a junior member of the ''[[Institut universitaire de France]]'' from 2007 to 2012. In 2008, she returned to Grenoble to become a professor at ''PHELMA'' and led a team within the ''LMGP'' on the study of the interfaces between materials and biological matter. In 2016, she had a sabbatical as visiting professor at [[Boston University]] with the support of a scholarship from the [[Fulbright Commission]]. Her work has focused on the engineering of biomaterials to control cell growth and the growth of [[Tissue (biology)|tissue]] ''[[in vivo]]'', as well as experimental biophysical models.<ref name="Grenoble INP">{{cite web|url=http://www.lmgp.grenoble-inp.fr/en/directory/catherine-picart-professor-at-grenoble-inp-1|title=Catherine Picart, Head of Department of Health at CEA Grenoble, Direction of Fundamental Research|website=www.lmgp.grenoble-inp.fr|archive-url=http://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/20180910114920/http://www.lmgp.grenoble-inp.fr/directory/catherine-picart-professor-at-grenoble-inp-261416.kjsp|archive-date=10 September 2018|access-date=29 December 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> She was appointed as a senior member of the ''Institut universitaire de France'' for the period 2016-2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/1578-catherine-picart.html|title=Cathérine PICART|website=www.iufrance.fr|archive-url=http://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/20191229213809/http://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/1578-catherine-picart.html|archive-date=29 December 2019|access-date=29 December 2019|url-status=live}}</ref>

Her research projects have been awarded [[European Research Council]] funding four times, in 2009 (biomimetic films and membranes), in 2012 (osteo-inductive coating of orthopaedic and dental implants), 2015 (bio-active coatings) and 2017 (regenerating large bone defects). She has had numerous responsibilities at national and international level, notably as an expert in biophysics and biomaterials for the ''[[:fr:Conseil national des universités|CNU]]'' (French National University Council) and the ''[[:fr:CNRS|CNRS]]'' ([[French National Centre for Scientific Research]]) national committee) or international (European funding agencies) organizations. She is the author or co-author of more than a hundred publications, including articles in major scientific journals and two American/European patents.<ref name="Grenoble INP"/><ref name="ERC">{{cite web|url=https://erc.europa.eu/projects-figures/erc-funded-projects/results?search_api_views_fulltext=picart|title=ERC FUNDED PROJECTS|website=erc.europa.eu|access-date=29 December 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Catherine_Picart|title=Catherine Picart
|website=www.researchgate.net|access-date=29 December 2019}}</ref>

* ''Le Prix Jeune Chercheur de la [https://www.biomecanique.org/index.php/fr/ Société de Biomécanique]'' [young researcher prize of the Society of Biomechanics]<ref name="Grenoble INP"/>

* 2019 [[:fr:Prix Émilia Valori pour l'application des sciences|Prix Émilia Valori pour l'application des sciences]] [Émilia Valori prize for the application of science] from the ''[[:fr:Académie des sciences (France)|Académie des sciences]]''<ref name="Grenoble INP"/>
